about: Sold zone locks (Metro Lock): one shop per trade per zone. The free report's open-spot line reads this list through workers/zone-locks.mjs. Until a lock is sold the list is empty and every zone is open. Add a lock only after the shop's Metro Lock (or Complete) first paid month starts. Never put a fake TEST shop here.

schema.trade: one of: Heating and air | Plumbing | Electrical (the form's trade names; Something else has no zone locks)
schema.zone: the zone name shown on the report, e.g. Smyrna
schema.towns: optional list of other town names this zone covers, e.g. ["La Vergne"] (the zone name itself always counts)
schema.business_name: the shop that holds the lock
schema.since: YYYY-MM-DD, the day the lock started
schema.until: optional YYYY-MM-DD, the last day of the lock (leave out while it runs)
